state:
**Goal `ext-host` is through Stage 2.** Both stage-2 checks run green: the configuration half (`crates/nvs-config/tests/extension.rs`) and the loader (`crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs`, check `nvs-ext-loading-refuses-everything-0246-names`). The design is ADR 0246 §§ 3–6 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; this goal has no record slot, so a question is decided in `crates/nvs-ext`'s module docs.

On disk: `crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs`, behind the `engine` feature, is `Loader::load`/`load_bytes`/`load_set` and `Set::insert`. Its module doc owns the refusal order (pin, component, sections, world version, imports, reserved namespace, exports; `Set::insert` the duplicate class), which Novis types the export check reads (structural ones only; named types are refused until the manifest carries them), and the import match (`WORLD_IMPORTS`, held equal to `wit/nvs-ext/world.wit` by a test; WASI at any `0.2.x`). `load::pin` is the digest as an entry's pin, ready for `nvs ext pin`. A refusal names the entry's path; the caller that knows the config line adds it. Test guests are hand-written component WAT (`guest()` in `tests/load.rs`), the sections added by `with_section` until the packer exists. Nothing calls the loader at boot or reload yet (Stage 6).

next.note: one file set: a new `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs`, a new `crates/nvs-ext/tests/pack.rs`, the root `Cargo.toml` (`wit-component` at the version `Cargo.lock` holds), `crates/nvs-ext/src/lib.rs`.

items.text: **Pack a component or a core module, a manifest and source files into a `.nvsx` that `Loader::load_bytes` accepts, the same bytes each time** — `rule:packaging/nvs-ext-is-the-authoring-tool`. A core module is componentized with `wit-component` against `wit/nvs-ext/world.wit`'s `extension` world and the manifest's interface; the sections are appended as `crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs:14`'s `with_section` does; source paths checked with `crates/nvs-ext/src/source.rs:85`'s `is_relative_source_path`. Test names are the check `nvs-ext-the-packer-writes-a-nvsx-that-loads`'s; the loaded proof uses `crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:186`'s `Loader`.

**Move `crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs:14`'s helper onto the packer where it can** — the goal's Stage 2 note says the packer replaces the helper; keep the hand-written guest for the refusals the packer would itself refuse.

backlog: The export check refuses named Novis types (enum, `Core` value class, union of shapes, `resource`) until the manifest names them — goal `ext-compiler` owns that; module doc of `crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs`.

`tests/load.rs` exercises only `string`, `bool`, `float` through the matcher; arrays, `?T`, shapes and `mixed` need a guest each — add with the packer's componentize path, which writes the core signatures.
Boot and reload call `Loader::load_set` and add the config file and line to a `Refused` — Stage 6, `rule:packaging/extension-loading-is-root-controlled`.
